title: SW50 Force Collector Problems
symptom: After changing the sensor, the smartwatch (SW50) used as a collector receives values from the Dexcom G6 but does not transmit them to xDrip when 'Force Collector' is activated. xDrip and SW50 both function as data collectors without problems when Force Collector is not activated.
cause: The user suspects the problem is caused by the latest Wear OS update in April, but no definitive cause is established.
fix: A workaround suggested by jokellerweb: disconnect the watch completely and reset, then reconnect. This works until the next sensor change. Another suggestion by Unrealsweb: reset the Wear DB, then restart watch and smartphone, but this was not successful for jokellerweb.
evidence_quote: A little cumbersome Solution: . Disconnet the watch completely and reset. Reconnect. Then it works again until the next sensor change.
